text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens, loose leaves in green, deep red-purple and speckled tones, some ruffled lettuce-like leaves and whole spinach-like leaves, slightly glossy with moisture, covering the left half of a white square plate, roughly 12 cm across and 2-3 cm tall at the mound, with a few small red cherry tomato halves scattered through it | 110

ITEM 2 | Cherry tomato halves and whole small red tomatoes, glossy red skin with pale interior, scattered among greens and on the right side of the plate, each about 2-3 cm across | 35

ITEM 3 | Roasted chicken drumstick, golden-brown to amber skin with darker charred edges, slightly glistening, smooth rounded shape about 4 cm wide and 10 cm long, lying diagonally in the center-right of the plate | 120

ITEM 4 | Roasted chicken thigh piece, golden-brown crisp skin with some darker spots, rounded lobed shape about 6 cm across and 3 cm tall, sitting on the right beside the drumstick | 110

ITEM 5 | Fine golden-tan grain-like crumbs, small granular texture, slightly moist and clumped, with bits of herbs and flecks of red pepper, spread across the right side of the plate over and around the chicken, about 8 cm by 6 cm and 1 cm deep | 60

ITEM 6 | Bright green thin stalks of cooked chives or similar slender greens, glossy and slightly limp, arranged in a fan across the lower right of the plate, each about 0.3 cm thick and 8-10 cm long | 25

ITEM 7 | Glossy oily sheen and small pale droplets of dressing or pan juices visible on the greens and around the chicken, thin film, no clear pooling | 5
